test_title: PYST 6: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Only one person is sitting between C and D (when counted from one side only). B is sitting second to the left of D. A is sitting to the immediate right of B. Who is sitting on the immediate left of B?
solution:
**Given**: Five persons A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order).

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangements:

1. Only one person is sitting between C and D (when counted from one side only).

2. B is sitting second to the left of D.

From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2c27e3fce5b44faeed58e6a394a2abae56add3518751b227fae393a16a7c07e.png] 

3. A is sitting to the immediate right of B.

From this, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcb565eddb02d6b45d224076d270cdf83df0ef4a6f06796d003d14b869acc30b.png] 

Now, only E is left, who takes the vacant place and we get the final arrangement as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f819740188dfb2461cf76eaa854e14d34481f1a90a30990fd919528f26bfd82.png] 

Therefore, C sits to the immediate left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**”
